title: Philips FMV Demonstration Disc native pause/continue
symptom: The Play Control sample accepts Pause and Continue, but disc DMA, decoding, presentation, and audio do not resume
expected: Continue resumes the paused MPEG sequence from retained state

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: CDFM ss_cont expects CDIC command $24 or retained PCL state to restart Mode-2 delivery, but the current CDIC model finishes idle without restoring the producer path.
supporting_evidence: Philips play_control.c calls mv_continue followed by ss_cont.
VMPEG records one Continue and returns to playing, while CDIC ends idle on command $24.
DMA words and presented frames remain exactly at their paused values.
contradicting_evidence: The exact CDIC command-$24 resume semantics have not yet been recovered from a primary driver or firmware trace.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Trace the guest ss_cont path and CDIC/PCL state from the command write through the next sector. If the guest never requests a restarted producer or command $24 is documented as reset-only, this explanation is incomplete.

context.scenario: FMVDemo Play Control native Pause then Continue

experiments.strategy: Drive the title's own controls, retain the pause and continue milestones, and require DMA and presentation counters to advance after Continue.
assumptions: The on-disc Play Control path is representative of native CD-RTOS pause/continue.
experiments.expected: DMA and presented-frame counters advance after Continue with no decoder errors.
experiments.actual: Continue count reached one and VMPEG playing returned true, but DMA remained at 1,860,244 words and presentation at 535 frames; CDIC was idle on $24 and both FIFOs underflowed.
improvements: The unresolved pause path is now deterministic and executable without commercial media.
experiments.evidence_quality: high: direct Philips sample source plus bounded native-title diagnostics

conditions: CD-i 220/Mono-I VMPEG using native CDFM pause/continue
invalidated_by: Changes to CDIC command $24, CDFM/PCL resume, DMA2, or VMPEG continue semantics
repeat_when: Any invalidating dependency changes or primary command documentation is found
